The '''Tularan Skyway''' was a major thoroughfare on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] that passed through the industrial zone which surrounded one of Taris's primary power plants. The Skyway was destroyed<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3956 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]] [[Destruction of Taris|bombarded]] the planet, and in the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] afterward, the area became known as the [[Tularan Marsh]]. However, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was unable to determine who or what the Skyway, and subsequently the Marsh, had been named after.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tularan Skyway was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Tularan Marsh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
